controls.label: Query matrix Q
controls.help: Two query rows. Changing a query entry changes the raw dot products, so the Similarity scores S, the Attention weights A, First weight w00 and the Weighted output O all move.

controls.label: Key matrix K
controls.help: Two key rows. Changing a key entry changes the dot products in the same column of the Similarity scores S, which rescales that column of Attention weights A and shifts the Weighted output O.

controls.label: Value matrix V
controls.help: Two value rows. Changing a value entry leaves the Similarity scores S and Attention weights A unchanged but changes the Weighted output O, because O averages the value rows using those weights.

controls.label: Scaling dimension dk
controls.help: Sets the divisor sqrt(dk)*T while the scaling switch is on. Larger dk divides the raw dot products more, shrinking the Similarity scores S, flattening the Attention weights A and moving First weight w00 toward 0.5.

controls.label: Temperature T
controls.help: Extra divisor factor. Larger T shrinks the Similarity scores S toward zero, so the Attention weights A flatten, First weight w00 approaches 0.5 and the Weighted output O moves toward the plain average of the value rows.

controls.label: Scaling switch
controls.help: Off uses the raw dot products of Q and K; on divides them by sqrt(dk)*T. The switch changes the Similarity scores S first, then the Attention weights A, First weight w00 and the Weighted output O.

explorations.title: Equal scores give flat weights
explorations.instruction: Predict: if both query rows score the same against both key rows, what will the two entries of each attention row be? Then apply the preset, which sets the Query matrix Q, the Key matrix K, the Value matrix V, the Scaling dimension dk, the Temperature T and the Scaling switch.
explorations.observe: Every entry of Similarity scores S equals 1.4142, so Attention weights A becomes a constant 0.5 in all four cells, First weight w00 reads 0.5, Row sums of weights r reads 1 and 1, and the Weighted output O becomes 0.5 and 0.5 in both rows.
explorations.why: When all scores in a row are equal, the row maximum subtracted inside softmax leaves zero for every entry, so each exponential is 1 and each weight is 1 divided by the number of keys, that is 0.5. The values are then averaged in equal parts.

explorations.title: A dominant score sharpens the weights
explorations.instruction: Predict: if one key matches a query much better than the other, how will the two entries of that weight row split? Then apply the preset, which sets the Query matrix Q, the Key matrix K, the Value matrix V, the Scaling dimension dk, the Temperature T and the Scaling switch.
explorations.observe: Similarity scores S becomes 1.4142 and 0 in each row, Attention weights A becomes about 0.8044 and 0.1956, First weight w00 rises to about 0.8044, Row sums of weights r stays at 1 and 1, and the Weighted output O puts about 0.8044 of the first value row into each output row.
explorations.why: The gap between the two scores, 1.4142, survives softmax as a ratio of exponentials, and a bigger gap concentrates more weight on the winning key. The Scaling switch and Temperature T act before softmax: turning scaling off, or lowering T, widens the gap and pushes w00 higher; raising T shrinks the gap and pulls w00 back toward 0.5.
